service: cracker-backend

custom:
  stage: ${opt:stage, env:STAGE, 'dev'}
  region: ap-south-1

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs24.x
  versionFunctions: false
  region: ap-south-1
  stage: ${self:custom.stage}
  timeout: 60

  environment:
    JWT_SECRET: ${env:JWT_SECRET}

    CART_TABLE: Carts-${self:custom.stage}
    PRODUCTS_TABLE: Products-${self:custom.stage}
    ORDERS_TABLE: Orders-${self:custom.stage}
    BULK_ORDERS_TABLE: BulkOrders-${self:custom.stage}
    BRAND_TABLE: Brands-${self:custom.stage}
    CATEGORY_TABLE: Categories-${self:custom.stage}
    USERS_TABLE: Users-${self:custom.stage}
    ADMIN_CONFIG_TABLE: AdminConfig-${self:custom.stage}
    DISCOUNT_TABLE: Discounts-${self:custom.stage}
    CONTACT_TABLE: ContactUs-${self:custom.stage}
    COUPONS_TABLE: Coupons-${self:custom.stage}
    OTP_TABLE: OtpTable-${self:custom.stage}

    OTP_TEMPLATE_ID: ${env:OTP_TEMPLATE_ID}
    CONFIRM_ORDER_TID: ${env:CONFIRM_ORDER_TID}
    ORDER_SUBMIT_TID: ${env:ORDER_SUBMIT_TID}
    PAYMENT_CONFIRM_TID: ${env:PAYMENT_CONFIRM_TID}
    CART_UPDATED_TID: ${env:CART_UPDATED_TID}
    ORDER_DISPATCHED_TID: ${env:ORDER_DISPATCHED_TID}
    MSG91_ESTIMATE_TEMPLATE: ${env:MSG91_ESTIMATE_TEMPLATE}
    MSG91_EMAIL_FROM: ${env:MSG91_EMAIL_FROM}
    MSG91_EMAIL_DOMAIN: ${env:MSG91_EMAIL_DOMAIN}
    MSG91_EMAIL_FROM_NAME: ${env:MSG91_EMAIL_FROM_NAME}
    DOMAIN: ${env:DOMAIN}
    MSG91_AUTH_KEY: ${env:MSG91_AUTH_KEY}
    RECAPTCHA_SECRET: ${env:RECAPTCHA_SECRET}
    MAX_AI_PRODUCT_QTY: 10
    REGION: ap-south-1

  httpApi:
    cors:
      allowedOrigins:
        - http://localhost:5173
        - https://frontend-cracker-shop.vercel.app
        - https://d1wqhtxjg6zqoo.cloudfront.net
        - https://sivakasipyropark.co.in
        - https://www.sivakasipyropark.co.in
        - https://dz9f4nfbnyjk1.cloudfront.net
        - https://www.sivakasicrackers.co.in
        - https://sivakasicrackers.co.in
      allowedHeaders:
        - Content-Type
        - Authorization
        - x-guest-id
      allowedMethods:
        - GET
        - POST
        - PUT
        - DELETE
        - PATCH
      allowCredentials: false

    binaryMediaTypes:
      - application/pdf

            - dynamodb:PutItem
            - dynamodb:UpdateItem

            - dynamodb:DeleteItem
            - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
            - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem

            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Products-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Products-${self:custom.stage}/index/*
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Categories-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Brands-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Discounts-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Carts-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Orders-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Orders-${self:custom.stage}/index/*
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/BulkOrders-${self:custom.stage}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/BulkOrders-${self:custom.stage}/index/*

            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:custom.region}:*:table/Coupons-${self:custom.stage}

            - s3:ListBucket
          Resource:
            - arn:aws:s3:::cracker-app-${self:custom.stage}

            - s3:PutObject
            - s3:GetObject
            - s3:DeleteObject

            - arn:aws:s3:::cracker-app/imports/*

            - arn:aws:s3:::cracker-app/categories/*

resources:
  Resources:
    ProductImagesBucket:
      Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
      Properties:
        BucketName: cracker-app-${self:custom.stage}
        PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
          BlockPublicAcls: false
          BlockPublicPolicy: false
          IgnorePublicAcls: false
          RestrictPublicBuckets: false
        CorsConfiguration:
          CorsRules:
            - AllowedOrigins:
                - http://localhost:5173
                - https://frontend-cracker-shop.vercel.app
                - https://www.sivakasicrackers.co.in
                - https://www.sivakasipyropark.co.in
              AllowedMethods:
                - GET
                - PUT
                - POST
              AllowedHeaders:
                - "*"
              MaxAge: 3000
    ProductImagesBucketPolicy:
      Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
      Properties:
        Bucket: cracker-app-${self:custom.stage}
        PolicyDocument:
          Version: "2012-10-17"
          Statement:
            - Sid: PublicReadProductImages
              Effect: Allow
              Principal: "*"
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
              Resource:
                - arn:aws:s3:::cracker-app-${self:custom.stage}/products/*
                - arn:aws:s3:::cracker-app-${self:custom.stage}/categories/*
                - arn:aws:s3:::cracker-app-${self:custom.stage}/brands/*
                - arn:aws:s3:::cracker-app-${self:custom.stage}/imports/*
                - arn:aws:s3:::cracker-app-${self:custom.stage}/config/*

    UsersTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: Users
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: mobile
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: mobile
            KeyType: HASH

    BrandsTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: Brands
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: brandId
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: brandId
            KeyType: HASH

    CategoriesTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: Categories
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: categoryId
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: categoryId
            KeyType: HASH

    OrdersTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: Orders
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: orderId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: meta
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: userId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: createdAt
            AttributeType: N
          - AttributeName: status
            AttributeType: S

        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: orderId
            KeyType: HASH
          - AttributeName: meta
            KeyType: RANGE

        GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
          - IndexName: userId-createdAt-index
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: userId
                KeyType: HASH
              - AttributeName: createdAt
                KeyType: RANGE
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL

          - IndexName: meta-createdAt-index
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: meta
                KeyType: HASH
              - AttributeName: createdAt
                KeyType: RANGE
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL

          - IndexName: status-meta-index
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: status
                KeyType: HASH
              - AttributeName: meta
                KeyType: RANGE
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL

    BulkOrdersTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: BulkOrders
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: orderId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: meta
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: userId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: createdAt
            AttributeType: N
          - AttributeName: status
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: orderId
            KeyType: HASH
          - AttributeName: meta
            KeyType: RANGE
        GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
          - IndexName: userId-createdAt-index
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: userId
                KeyType: HASH
              - AttributeName: createdAt
                KeyType: RANGE
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
          - IndexName: meta-createdAt-index
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: meta
                KeyType: HASH
              - AttributeName: createdAt
                KeyType: RANGE
